model.main_precision: standard Q4_0 with Q6_K vocabulary projection

native_encoded_video.temporal_behavior: mtmd decodes the container and Qwen3-VL merges successive frames in pairs

patches.retain_mtmd_video_context: Keep the mtmd_helper_video owner alive until lazy video expansion and release it with RAII.
patches.configure_video_sampling: Expose MTMD_VIDEO_FPS and MTMD_VIDEO_TIMESTAMP_INTERVAL_MS without changing upstream defaults.
patches.reap_video_subprocesses: Join and destroy ffmpeg/ffprobe children after normal EOF even when the wrapper-level alive flag is clear.
patches.wire_server_grammar: Forward the already-declared grammar_path and grammar_string request fields into SamplerConfig.

persistent_service.independent_request_behavior: KV cache reset between requests; model and HTP backend remain loaded

quality_first_cpu_vision_npu_decoder.remaining_error: Fire evacuation primary returns C instead of D.

interpretation.positive: A persistent patched GenieX service now accepts encoded MP4, uses temporal frame pairing, keeps the language decoder on the IQ-9075 NPU, and reaches 7/8 on the bounded frozen panel with closed-set decoding.
interpretation.precision_caveat: The quality result requires CPU placement for the vision encoder/projector. The fast all-NPU placement loses two additional cases. The BF16 and GGUF paths use different video preprocessing, chat wrappers, and numerical precision.
interpretation.optimization_stop_condition: The remaining fire error is a valid in-grammar semantic prediction. More grammar or lifecycle work cannot fix it; further quality work should require a new quantization, broader calibration data, or a materially larger benchmark.

verdict: Native encoded-video inference is now practically usable as a bounded experimental service. The recommended quality profile is CPU vision plus NPU decoder with closed-set grammar: 7/8 on the frozen four-scene/two-order panel and 4/4 on the focused box/near control. The faster all-NPU profile is 5/8. This is strong project evidence, not broad accuracy, safety qualification, tensor equivalence, or vendor certification.
